subject: Last-minute volume lift and sculpted overrun agreement
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@atlashealth.com>, Maya Blanco <maya@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Last-minute volume lift & proposed overrun mitigation

Hi Samir / Maya,

Thanks for the heads-up on the unexpected traffic this week. I pulled the usage reports (attached) and can confirm AtlasHealth spiked ~3.8x above the committed QPS window on 2027-04-26 during the API rollout.

We want to make sure you don’t see degraded latency while you finish the rollout. Below is an operational proposal to cover the short window while we evaluate a mid-term commit uplift: 

- Immediate: Temporary headroom for 72 hours at a blended overrun rate of $0.018/token (vs standard $0.025) capped at an incremental $30k for the window.
- Short-term: If daily volume stays >2x baseline after the 72h, we’ll convert to a provisional 30-day uplift tier at a reduced per-token rate to avoid repeated overrun charges.
- Billing: Any credit/true-up will appear on next invoice; we’ll provide a prorated statement for reconciliation.

Attached is a draft amendment that captures the blended rate and the $30k cap. Marissa, can you confirm we have approval to apply this cap from finance? Dev, can you stand by to triage if we need to swap model variants to cheaper quantized instances?

Samir — if you’re comfortable, reply with approval and we’ll flip the headroom on within the hour. If procurement prefers DocuSign, we can route the amendment there.

Best,
Rafael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AtlasHealth_MonthlyUsageReport.pdf (report, 12 pages); DraftOverrunAmendment.docx (proposal)

From: Samir Khan <samir@atlashealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Blanco <maya@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: 2027-04-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Last-minute volume lift & proposed overrun mitigation

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the quick analysis.

We were pushing a dark-launch and unexpectedly ramped a config flag; apologies for the surprise. The 72-hour headroom works for us in principle. A couple of asks before we sign: 

1) Can you confirm whether the blended overrun rate applies across all model classes (chat/generation/embeddings) or only generation tokens?
2) We need usage-level detail broken down by route/model for our internal chargeback (can you provide a CSV export).
3) Procurement prefers DocuSign for any billing changes — please send the document.

If you can answer 1–2 and send the DocuSign link, I’ll escalate to Maya and procurement for quick turnaround.

—Samir
Head of Integrations, AtlasHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@atlashealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Last-minute volume lift & proposed overrun mitigation

Samir — quick answers: 

1) The blended $0.018/token applies to generation/chat tokens only; embeddings remain at standard overrun rates (we can extend a separate blended rate if you need).
2) Rafael — I exported the per-route usage and attached a CSV (RouteBreakdown_Atlas_20270426.csv). Samir, I’ll upload to the HubSpot file tab and also copy to procurement.
3) Rafael / Rafael@ops — please initiate the DocuSign envelope for the amendment and mark it "urgent" for procurement.

Grace — can you sign off on the $30k cap from a finance perspective? We ran the numbers and it aligns with our discretionary emergency credit policy.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RouteBreakdown_Atlas_20270426.csv (route-level usage)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T13:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Last-minute volume lift & proposed overrun mitigation

Marissa — confirmed. Finance approves a one-time discretionary cap of $30,000 for AtlasHealth with the following conditions: 

- AtlasHealth signs the amendment within 5 business days.
- We will apply the blended overrun rate for generation/chat; embeddings excluded unless a separate request is submitted.
- We need procurement acceptance via DocuSign and internal GL code for reconciliation.

Rafael — you have finance sign-off; proceed when procurement approves.

Grace
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Last-minute volume lift & proposed overrun mitigation

Samir / Procurement team —

Thanks — sending the DocuSign now. Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/transaction/XYZ-1234 (envelope: "AtlasHealth Temporary Headroom Amendment").

Two quick operational notes: 
- We flipped the headroom flag at 08:15 PT; metrics show tail latency unchanged but total token rate remains elevated. We’ll monitor hourly.
- Dev is standing by to re-route requests to the lower-cost quantized variant if Atlas wants to cap token spend sooner.

Please sign the DocuSign and reply-all with a quick confirmation so finance can apply the credit on the next invoice.

Rafael

From: procurement@atlashealth.com <procurement@atlashealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T17:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Last-minute volume lift & proposed overrun mitigation

Rafael / Marissa —

Procurement reviewed and signed the DocuSign envelope this morning. DocuSign ID: XYZ-1234. We also received the CSV and route breakdown — thanks for the speedy delivery.

Two final items for our AP team: 
1) Please confirm the invoice line to expect the $30k credit against (GL code or invoice reference).
2) We request your team produce a short reconciliation statement showing the pre-credit overrun total and the applied credit for our auditors.

Once we have that, we’ll close the billing loop and confirm payment timing for the remainder.

—procurement@atlashealth.com
AtlasHealth Accounts Payable
